tools.name: search_manotr
tools.description: Search Manotr's website content — products, research areas, media and OTT capabilities, selected work, and frequently asked questions. Use this first for any question about what Manotr does, builds, or has deployed.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Manotr's products with a one-line description and a link to each.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail for one Manotr product: what it does, who it is for, how it deploys, and its FAQ.

tools.name: which_product
tools.description: Given a problem described in the user's own words, recommend which Manotr product(s) address it and explain why. Use this when someone describes a situation rather than naming a product. It matches on the description only and says so when nothing fits — it never invents a capability.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Send an enquiry to the Manotr team. Only call this when the person has actually asked to be put in touch and has given you their name and email address. Do not call it to test the connection, and do not invent contact details.
